title: A change of plans ripples through the document
task: We're leaving a day late because of the kids' school concert, so we'll get there Saturday instead of Friday. Can you update the plan?

checks.description: The agent reads the document before it edits anything.
Every id the agent passes to an edit came from a result it was given.
Neither the Friday departure nor the opening's "driving up Friday" is left.
The headings and the Packing list are untouched.
The agent finishes in 12 tool calls or fewer.
The agent updated the opening paragraph as well as the schedule, because both said Friday, and told the person what it changed.

source.basis: The demo scenario: a plan changes and everything that depended on it has to change.
